guard/30918.htm.text: Guard Kent: Greetings! I am Kent of hte Heine Guards. If you follow this road west it will take you by a vast field of reeds. Althought it appears peaceful, occasionally some dangerous creatures show up there. You must be careful.

links.text: "Tell me about the field of reeds."
Ask about the local lord and tax rate.

guard/30918-1.htm.text: Guard Kent: Reeds have taken over the marshland in recent years. So much so that it is no longer called Innadril Mashland. Now it is known as the Field of Reeds. This road will take you to the Field of Whispers . Further north you will find the Field of Silence . They say the reeds there hold their…

links.text: "Tell me about the Field of Whispers."

guard/30918-2.htm.text: Guard Kent: Ah yes, the Field of Whispers... There is a story that is hard to tell! For many years that place served as a secret rendevous for lovers, far away from prying eyes... My heart races just thinking of that place!
